title: Signature 48 · USSBBW · Irezumi Waves · Cream Studio
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her late 30s, sleek high bun with red lacquer kanzashi.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 800 pounds — an enormous soft apron belly hanging in several heavy overlapping rolls down to mid-thigh, deep creases between each roll, not pregnant, a gigantic bust resting on the belly, no waist at all, deep side rolls, hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso, huge thighs pressed together, enormous soft upper arms, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body Japanese irezumi body painting painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. A bright indigo and white ground of continuous curling white-crested waves with vermilion and gold wind bars and scattered cherry petals. The waves cover the whole body, each belly roll carrying its own curling white-crested wave, darker pigment settling into each deep crease. Not black shading, no dragons, no koi. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing full frontal with her feet planted far apart, arms relaxed slightly away from the body, never covering the belly, so every roll is fully visible.

Footwear: Extremely high vermilion lacquer platform stiletto mules. Nails: extra long almond, vermilion with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: A seamless warm cream studio backdrop with no props, the background much lighter than her body, soft warm light from one side carving deep shadows between each belly roll, making the glossy colors gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
